note: Built from the official trophy descriptions. The only missable trophy is Positive Mental Attitude — do its Chapter 1 balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends.

stages.name: Story — Chapters 1 to 4 and the finale
stages.text: Play the story straight through, Chapters 1 to 4 and the final mission. Every chapter and story mission has its own trophy, so just finishing the story earns 13 of them. On the way, stop at Ocean Beach for a cocktail (In The Beginning…) and — most important — meditate at the Chapter 1 balcony spot for Positive Mental Attitude before Chapter 1 ends. It is the only trophy you can miss.

stages.name: Cleanup — strangers, activities and stunts
stages.text: After the story, work the open world. Finish the stranger strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and three more for Strangers & Freaks), then the activities: 250 stunts, the 42 Shooting Range golds, drone races at all 14 spots, 20 race wins, fishing against Cal, the arcade and bowling. Rob the vaults, trucks and gang operations, lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner, and chase the odd ones — the two with no confirmed method at launch (Bad Luck, I Guess and Ten Pin) are listed honestly in their guides.

stages.name: Mop-up — collectibles, money and 100%
stages.text: Finish the collectibles: the card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 100 vehicles, all 52 areas of Leonida, the 8 garages and 10 Scooter Bros registrations. Then the money: launder $250,000 of marked bills and spend $100,000 in the shops. When everything else is done, 100% completion (A Long Road) and the platinum (Vice Got a Price!) pop together.

title: Road to the Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
